title: City or Not City? POV: Walking Chongqing, China's 8D Magic City | China Travel Expert
description:
"City or not city?" — the viral line fits nowhere better than Chongqing. Built across steep hills and river gorges, this megacity stacks roads, railways and whole neighbourhoods on top of each other, which is why people online call it China's "8D magic city."

The vertical geography is real: because of the terrain, what looks like a building's ground-floor entrance can actually sit level with another building's 20th floor, and Chongqing Rail Transit Line 2 famously runs straight through the middle floors of a 19-storey apartment block at Liziba station. There's no flat street grid — you navigate by ramps, stairs, escalators and sky-bridges.

🧭 Expert Tip: don't trust your map's "floor" — use the pedestrian bridges and outdoor escalators between levels, and give yourself extra time; the shortest route is rarely a straight line here.

"是城市还是不是城市?" 重庆建在山和江之间，道路、轻轨和楼房层层叠叠，被叫作"8D魔幻城市"：一栋楼的"一层"可能和另一栋的20层齐平，轻轨2号线还从李子坝一栋19层居民楼里穿过。
